subject: RE: Quick 20-min demo — availability this week?
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Kim <alex.kim@railway.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Jun 4, 2026 at 09:12 AM PDT
Subject: Quick 20-min demo — availability this week?

Hi Alex —

Congrats on the spike — our usage monitor flagged Railway's project for a steady uptick in token consumption (great signal). I wanted to offer a short, timeboxed 20-minute walkthrough to show a few quick wins you can enable immediately (prefix caching, a suggested batching profile, and a one-page latency/cost snapshot).

Suggested slots (PDT):
- Thu 6/4, 11:00–11:20 AM
- Thu 6/4, 2:00–2:20 PM
- Fri 6/5, 10:00–10:20 AM

If none of those work, grab whatever fits here: https://calendly.com/redwood-sdr/20min. I attached a one-pager and a short agenda so you know what to expect.

Agenda (20 min):
- 5 min: quick intro + goals
- 8 min: targeted config & quick wins for Railway AI
- 5 min: next steps & mutual action plan

If you'd like a more technical touchpoint, happy to include Marissa (cc'd).

Cheers,
Connor O'Brien
SDR, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachments: demo-one-pager.pdf (PDF), 20min-agenda.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@railway.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, Jun 4, 2026 at 10:05 AM PDT
Subject: Re: Quick 20-min demo — availability this week?

Thanks Connor — appreciate the proactive reach. 2:00 PM PDT today works for us. Can you also add Tim (tim.ops@railway.ai) — he'll join from our infra team.

A couple quick notes:
- We're most interested in reducing 95th percentile latency for short interactive flows and keeping costs predictable as we scale.
- We use a mix of cached prompts + ad-hoc user-generated text; curious how Redwood's prefix caching would slot into that.

See you at 2:00. Please send an invite with a Zoom link.

—Alex
Alex Kim
Head of Product, Railway AI
alex.kim@railway.ai
